sources.title: THC Cannabis Plant Science Source Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Project-controlled internal source map; use for architecture and cross-links, not final standalone proof.

sources.title: THC Cultivation SOP Source Materials Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Project-controlled source map for greenhouse environment, irrigation, IPM, safety, and postharvest boundaries.

sources.title: NOAA — U.S. Climate Normals, 1991–2020
sources.useAndLimitation: Official 30-year climate baselines; normals describe historical distributions, not guaranteed future weather.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Web Soil Survey
sources.useAndLimitation: Official mapped soil information for planning; onsite sampling and investigation remain necessary.

sources.title: Zhang et al. 2021 — Photoperiodic flowering response of hemp cultivars
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific controlled-room and field study showing cultivar-specific critical photoperiod and twilight response.

sources.title: Leckie et al. 2024 — Loss of daylength sensitivity in Cannabis
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis genetics study supporting photoperiod-insensitive flowering as a genetic trait with transfer limits.

sources.title: Nimmala et al. 2024 — Cannabis pollen dispersal across the United States
sources.useAndLimitation: Meteorology-driven Cannabis pollen-dispersion modeling; supports regional and time-of-day risk analysis, not a universal isolation distance.

sources.title: Bajwa et al. 2025 — Subsurface drip irrigation in outdoor tunnel Cannabis
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific tunnel field experiment comparing surface and subsurface drip under defined soil, cultivar, density, and climate.

sources.title: Mantel et al. 2025 — Water use and productivity of Cannabis sativa
sources.useAndLimitation: Field-scale water-use study in South Africa; climate, genotype, management, and system specific.

sources.title: Llewellyn et al. 2024 — Environmental impact of outdoor Cannabis production
sources.useAndLimitation: Three-season outdoor fertilizer-response field data incorporated into life-cycle assessment; not a universal input recipe.

sources.title: Bernstein et al. 2024 — Saline irrigation effects in hemp
sources.useAndLimitation: Controlled hemp study showing biomass and composition responses to defined salinity treatments; cultivar and system specific.

sources.title: Drought-stress study in hemp fiber, 2019–2021
sources.useAndLimitation: Controlled multi-year study of soil-moisture treatments and fiber responses; one cultivar and method.

sources.title: Munir et al. 2026 — Latent Fusarium infection in hemp fields
sources.useAndLimitation: Multisite, multi-year field evidence linking infection timing with flowering, rain, and RH; pathogen and region specific.

sources.title: Buirs et al. 2025 — Botrytis epidemiology and management in greenhouse cannabis
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific greenhouse experiments; cultivar, isolate, inoculation, and environment bound.

sources.title: Mahmoud et al. 2023 — Botrytis bud-rot development in greenhouse cannabis
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis-specific disease-development study under defined greenhouse conditions.

sources.title: Rodriguez-Morrison et al. 2024 — Supplemental greenhouse lighting and Cannabis water-use efficiency
sources.useAndLimitation: Cannabis greenhouse experiment linking DLI, growth, evapotranspiration, and water-use efficiency.

sources.title: Charles et al. 2024 — High-tunnel versus open-field hemp production
sources.useAndLimitation: Two-cultivar comparison of yield, cannabinoids, and volatile profiles; system and cultivar specific.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Irrigation Water Management Standard 449
sources.useAndLimitation: Official planning criteria; local Field Office Technical Guide and qualified design control implementation.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Microirrigation Standard 441
sources.useAndLimitation: Official microirrigation planning standard; local adaptations and engineering review required.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Cover Crop Standard 340
sources.useAndLimitation: Official conservation-practice framework; species and termination choices require local agronomic review.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Mulching Standard 484
sources.useAndLimitation: Official conservation-practice framework; material, depth, fire, pest, and contamination limits require local review.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — High Tunnel System Standard 325
sources.useAndLimitation: Official high-tunnel planning framework; structural, snow, wind, drainage, and local code requirements control design.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Windbreak/Shelterbelt Standard 380
sources.useAndLimitation: Official wind-protection planning framework; orientation and porosity must be designed for the site.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Fence Standard 382 and Wildlife Habitat standards
sources.useAndLimitation: Official exclusion and conservation framework; lawful wildlife handling and local ecological effects require review.

sources.title: Hirano et al. 1995 — Physical effects of dust on leaf physiology
sources.useAndLimitation: Controlled cucumber and bean study showing dust effects on shading, stomata, leaf temperature, and photosynthesis; not Cannabis-specific.

sources.title: González et al. 2014 — Atmospheric dust and leaf gas exchange
sources.useAndLimitation: Field comparison across 17 species; supports species- and leaf-trait-dependent particulate effects.

sources.title: U.S. EPA — Wildfire smoke resources, 2026
sources.useAndLimitation: Official worker/public smoke and air-quality framework; not a crop-release or product-safety standard.

sources.title: Cranshaw et al. / hemp pest-spectrum synthesis
sources.useAndLimitation: Hemp pest and beneficial-arthropod occurrence framework; occurrence does not establish economic injury or control need.

sources.title: Gould et al. 2023 — Corn earworm damage across hemp varieties
sources.useAndLimitation: Two-year field study showing variety and floral maturity effects on injury; region and pest specific.

sources.title: Braman et al. 2022 — Tachinid parasitism of corn earworm in hemp
sources.useAndLimitation: Kentucky field survey showing natural-enemy activity and complex host-parasitoid outcomes.

sources.title: Water and wind stress effects on hemp chemistry and arthropod diversity, 2025
sources.useAndLimitation: Outdoor two-variety field experiment linking environmental stress, phytochemistry, and arthropod communities.

sources.title: USDA/University field research — Hemp herbicide drift
sources.useAndLimitation: Wind-tunnel drift study showing nozzle- and herbicide-specific downwind deposition and biomass effects.

sources.title: EPA — Agriculture and natural events and disasters
sources.useAndLimitation: Official planning framework for contamination, infrastructure damage, disease susceptibility, and lawful recovery.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — Conservation Practice Standards
sources.useAndLimitation: Official technical baseline for high tunnels, irrigation, cover crops, mulching, windbreaks, fencing, drainage, and stormwater controls.
